title: 第2119章 你的名字第2118章 何去何从
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2119章你的名字（..la）陈怡无比专注而又认真的看着宋文。
“阳羽前辈，对你而言，或许只是举手之劳，但对我却是救命之恩。此番你我前往西荒后，便会分别，还不知何日再能相见。前辈，请容我为你做点什么。”
“不用了。你也帮不了我任何事。”宋文淡淡开口。
他唤出一艘飞船，摄住陈怡，便双双登船。
既然决定要前往西荒，那便无需多作逗留。
哪料，落在飞船甲板上的陈怡，却揪着方才之事不放。
“前辈，我只有这具身子，还有几分姿色，不知前辈可否看得上？...前辈放心，我身子还是干净的，从未被任何男子碰过。”
宋文脸上闪过错愕，但很快又恢复了漠然。
“我说过，不用你做任何事情。”
陈怡身躯突然一垮，有些失落，又夹杂着一丝轻松。
“那我还真是无法为前辈做任何事了。但前辈刚刚还说，修仙界尔虞我诈。晚辈斗胆敢问，前辈数次救我，又是为何？”
宋文抬眸，望着远处天际那些迅速向后飞退的白云，缓缓道。
“或许是因...你的名字。”
......
两个月后，在一座只有几名炼气期修士的凡人小城外，宋文放下了陈怡。
对于陈怡再三的挽留，邀请宋文在城中暂住几日；宋文却毫不犹豫拒绝，驾船继续向西而行。
越发往西，灵气就越发稀薄，人烟也越发稀少。
宋文最终停在一座湖泊上空。
他放开神识，将湖泊及周边反复搜索，未发现任何异常，但神识却牢牢锁定了湖底的一个山洞。
骨九幽曾提及的那三座传送阵，其中一座便在这山洞之中。

不过，山洞似乎有某种隐匿阵法，以宋文的神识，也未窥得丝毫异样。
他闪身没入水中，来到山洞入口处。
又打量片刻，宋文终是缓缓往洞中飞去。
山洞通道蜿蜒，宋文前行数十里后，被一道无形屏障给拦了下来。
若非亲眼所见，宋文神识此前也未能发现这道屏障，他只能感知到——山洞到了尽头，乃是石壁。
“好生高明的隐匿阵法。看来邪灵修士之中，还真有阵法大师。不过，能布置传送阵之人，定然阵法造诣不俗。”
宋文没有试图强行攻破这道屏障，而是又取出了一面铁质令牌。
这枚令牌，同样出自骨九幽的储物戒。
骨九幽能通过传送阵，往返于两地，自然有法子穿过这道屏障。
令牌已被宋文炼化，注入一缕仙元力后，泛起淡淡的灰色光芒，笼罩宋文周身。
宋文徐徐飘向屏障。
在他触及屏障的瞬间，屏障如水面般泛起道道涟漪，令宋文很轻易便横穿而过。
屏障之后，别有洞天。
山洞急剧变大，一个宽达数里的地下洞厅，出现在宋文面前。
地下洞厅空无一人，中间位置有着一方石台。
石台上镌刻着极其繁复的阵纹。
宋文倒是大致能够确定，此乃传送阵无疑。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Among mortals cultivating immortality, who can be more yin than me! Volume 2: Mysterious World Chapter 2119 Your Name (..la) Chen Yi looked at Song Wen with great concentration and seriousness.
"Senior Yang Yu, it may be just a little effort for you, but it is a life-saving grace for me. After you and I go to the Western Wilderness this time, we will be separated, and I don't know when we will see each other again. Senior, please allow me to do something for you."
"No need. You can't help me with anything." Song Wen said calmly.
He summoned a spaceship, captured Chen Yi, and then both boarded the ship.
Since you have decided to go to the Western Wilderness, there is no need to stay longer.
Unexpectedly, Chen Yi, who landed on the deck of the spaceship, was holding on to what she had just done.
"Senior, I only have this body, and I still have some beauty. I wonder if senior can appreciate it?...Senior, don't worry, my body is still clean and I have never been touched by any man."
Astonishment flashed across Song Wen's face, but he quickly returned to indifference.
"I told you, you don't have to do anything."
Chen Yi's body suddenly collapsed, feeling a little disappointed, but also mixed with a sense of relief.
"Then I really can't do anything for senior. But senior just said that there are intrigues in the world of immortality. I dare to ask, why did senior save me several times?"
Song Wen raised his eyes, looked at the white clouds flying back quickly in the distant sky, and said slowly.
"Maybe it's because of...your name."
...
Two months later, Song Wen put Chen Yi down outside a small mortal city with only a few monks in the Qi Refining Stage.
In response to Chen Yi's repeated attempts to stay, Song Wen was invited to stay in the city for a few days; Song Wen refused without hesitation and continued to sail westward.
The further west you go, the spiritual energy becomes thinner and the population becomes sparser.
Song Wen finally stopped over a lake.
He let go of his spiritual consciousness and searched the lake and its surroundings repeatedly, but found nothing unusual, but his spiritual consciousness was firmly locked on a cave at the bottom of the lake.
One of the three teleportation arrays mentioned by Gu Jiuyou is in this cave.
However, there seemed to be some kind of hidden formation in the cave, and even with Song Wen's spiritual awareness, he couldn't detect anything strange.
He ducked into the water and came to the entrance of the cave.
After looking at it for a while, Song Wen finally slowly flew towards the cave.
The cave passage was winding. After Song Wen traveled dozens of miles, he was stopped by an invisible barrier.
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, Song Wen's spiritual consciousness would not have been able to detect this barrier before. He could only sense that at the end of the cave, there was a stone wall.
"What a brilliant concealment formation. It seems that there are indeed formation masters among the evil spirit monks. However, those who can set up teleportation formations must have good formation skills."
Song Wen did not try to forcefully break through the barrier, but took out another iron token.
This token also comes from Gu Jiuyou's storage ring.
Gu Jiuyou can travel between two places through the teleportation array, so he naturally has a way to pass through this barrier.
The token has been refined by Song Wen, and after injecting a ray of immortal power, a faint gray light glows, covering Song Wen's body.
Song Wen slowly floated towards the barrier.
The moment he touched the barrier, ripples appeared on the barrier like water, allowing Song Wen to easily cross it.
Behind the barrier, there is a different world.
The cave grew rapidly, and an underground cave hall several miles wide appeared in front of Song Wen.
The underground cave hall is empty, with a stone platform in the middle.
The stone platform is engraved with extremely complex formation patterns.
Song Wen was roughly certain that this was a teleportation array.
